about: One-line nudges for the decision screen, keyed to the failure notes the simulation writes into Outcome.notes (core/objective.gd build_outcome, port of prototype/src/core/objective.ts). Specification: docs/ONBOARDING.md, 'Failure hints'.

rules.matching: For each note of a FAILED resolved run, in order, find the first entry of 'hints' (file order = priority, most specific and most actionable first) whose 'match' regex matches the whole note; skip notes that match an 'ignore' regex. A note's signature is the hint id plus the values of the capture groups named in 'signature' (never the beat, which shifts between takes).
rules.streak: Keep a consecutive-failure count per signature for the current level visit. After each failed resolved run: signatures present get count + 1, signatures absent are dropped (count 0). A winning run clears everything. retryTake, commit and resetAll do NOT clear the counts: the same failure after a reset is still the same failure.
rules.choose: On entering 'decision' after a failed run, take the hints whose signature count is >= showAfter and which have not been shown this level visit; show the one earliest in file order. Show nothing if there is none.
rules.regex: PCRE-compatible, written with (?P<name>...) groups so the same source compiles in Godot RegEx and in Python. Match against the full note string.
rules.tokens: {tape} is replaced by the captured 'tape' letter rendered as the HUD names the cassette ('Tape A').

ignore.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. There is no boss in this level\.$
ignore.why: authoring error, not something the player can act on

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D])'s (?P<kind>\w+) at beat [0-9.]+ hit breakable wall (?P<id>.+) with momentum [0-9.]+; it needs [0-9.]+\.$
hints.text: Still bouncing off. Momentum is swing, run-up and tape speed. Stack them.
examples: Tape A's heavy at beat 2.02 hit breakable wall w1 with momentum 4; it needs 5.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D])'s (?P<kind>\w+) at beat [0-9.]+ hit core (?P<id>.+) with momentum [0-9.]+; it needs [0-9.]+\.$
hints.text: The core shrugged. It wants more behind the swing, same as a wall.
examples: Tape A's light at beat 1.07 hit core c1 with momentum 0.6; it needs 1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D])'s (?P<kind>\w+) at beat [0-9.]+ hit (?P<id>.+) but did no damage \(shield, momentum [0-9.]+\)\.$
hints.text: Shield's up every time you swing. Maybe don't swing alone.
examples: Tape A's light at beat 0.53 hit sh but did no damage (shield, momentum 1.2).

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D])'s (?P<kind>\w+) at beat [0-9.]+ hit (?P<id>.+) but did no damage \(armour, momentum [0-9.]+\)\.$
hints.text: It's armoured where it's looking. So who is it looking at?
examples: Tape A's heavy at beat 0.93 hit b1 but did no damage (armour, momentum 4).

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D])'s (?P<kind>\w+) at beat [0-9.]+ hit (?P<id>.+) but did no damage \(no damage, momentum [0-9.]+\)\.$
hints.text: That landed and did nothing. Slow tape, soft hands. Bring more momentum.
examples: Tape A's light at beat 0.87 hit g1 but did no damage (no damage, momentum 0.9).

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D])'s (?P<kind>\w+) at beat [0-9.]+ hit (?P<id>.+) but did no damage \((?P<reason>.+), momentum [0-9.]+\)\.$
hints.text: It shrugged that off. Try another angle, another beat, or another self.
examples: Tape B's heavy at beat 4 hit x9 but did no damage (parried, momentum 3).

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: struck by boss (?P<id>.+) \(remembering Tape (?P<remembered>[A-D])\)\.$
hints.text: It hit where a kept take stood. It only knows what you kept.
examples: Tape A died at beat 3: struck by boss b1 (remembering Tape A).

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: swept by boss (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: That sweep has a reach and a beat. Be outside one of them.
examples: Tape C died at beat 6.5: swept by boss b1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: struck by (?P<kind>\w+) (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: {tape}, same hit twice. They wind up first. Be elsewhere, or be first.
examples: Tape A died at beat 10: struck by grunt g1.
Tape A died at beat 11: struck by stalker s1.
Tape A died at beat 2: struck by brute b1.
Tape A died at beat 4: struck by boss b1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: burned by laser (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: Same beam, same crisp. Something in this room switches it off.
examples: Tape A died at beat 0.56: burned by laser beam.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: shot by dart launcher (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: That launcher only covers one lane. Learn when, or stay out of it.
examples: Tape B died at beat 5.25: shot by dart launcher dl1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: shot by a bolt\.$
hints.text: {tape} caught a stray. Check whose line of fire she walked through.
examples: Tape D died at beat 7: shot by a bolt.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: shot by (?P<kind>\w+) (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: Same shooter twice. Use cover, or give it someone else to watch.
examples: Tape A died at beat 13.83: shot by turret t1.
Tape A died at beat 7.33: shot by drone d1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: skewered by spikes (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: Spikes keep time with the track. Cross on the beat they rest.
examples: Tape A died at beat 4: skewered by spikes sp1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: crushed by crusher (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: The crusher's on a beat. Cross while it's lifting, not while it's deciding.
examples: Tape A died at beat 8: crushed by crusher cr1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: burned by flame jet (?P<id>.+)\.$
hints.text: The jet takes breaths. Move on the inhale.
examples: Tape B died at beat 2.5: burned by flame jet f1.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) died at beat [0-9.]+: (?P<cause>.+)\.$
hints.text: {tape} dies the same way each run. Change what happens just before.
examples: Tape A died at beat 1: flattened by something new.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \(blocked by door (?P<id>.+)\); its spark never caught up\.$
hints.text: {tape} walked into a door that used to be open. Who shut it?
examples: Tape A desynced at beat 0.59 (blocked by door d1); its spark never caught up.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \(blocked by breakable wall (?P<id>.+)\); its spark never caught up\.$
hints.text: {tape} expected a hole in that wall. Somebody has to make it first.
examples: Tape B desynced at beat 3 (blocked by breakable wall w1); its spark never caught up.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \(blocked by crusher (?P<id>.+)\); its spark never caught up\.$
hints.text: {tape} met the crusher mid-stroke. Its timing around her has changed.
examples: Tape A desynced at beat 6 (blocked by crusher cr1); its spark never caught up.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \(blocked by a wall\); its spark never caught up\.$
hints.text: {tape} skipped against solid wall. Something knocked her off her marks.
examples: Tape A desynced at beat 0.13 (blocked by a wall); its spark never caught up.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \(manual desync\); its spark never caught up\.$
hints.text: {tape} stepped out on purpose and never got back. Leave her a road.
examples: Tape A desynced at beat 0 (manual desync); its spark never caught up.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \((?P<cause>.+)\); its spark never caught up\.$
hints.text: {tape} got blocked and never caught up. Find what's newly in her way.
examples: Tape C desynced at beat 9 (blocked by gate g7); its spark never caught up.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) ended the run desynced: it survives, but it could not act or hold an exit\.$
hints.text: {tape} finished out of step. Clear her road sooner, or reroute her.
examples: Tape A ended the run desynced: it survives, but it could not act or hold an exit.

hints.match: ^No self survived to the end: the objective needs at least one survivor\.$
hints.text: Job done, nobody left. One of you has to be breathing at the end.
examples: No self survived to the end: the objective needs at least one survivor.

hints.match: ^Tape (?P<tape>[A-D]) desynced at beat [0-9.]+ \((?P<cause>.+)\); its spark caught up at beat [0-9.]+\.$
hints.text: {tape} skipped, then caught up. Whatever she did in between didn't count.
examples: Tape A desynced at beat 0.59 (blocked by door d1); its spark caught up at beat 10.71.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. No alive, synced self was in the exit when the encounter ended\.$
hints.text: Somebody alive has to be standing in the exit when the music stops.
examples: Objective not complete: Get out. No alive, synced self was in the exit when the encounter ended.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. The encounter has not ended yet\.$
hints.text: You cut it short. The exit only counts on the last beat.
examples: Objective not complete: Reach the end. The encounter has not ended yet.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. Still standing: (?P<left>.+)\.$
hints.text: Same stragglers both times. Somebody on the crew has a spare beat.
examples: Objective not complete: Take out both grunts and the turret. Still standing: grunt g1, grunt g2, turret t1.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. Not activated: (?P<left>.+)\.$
hints.text: Core's still cold. Nobody has actually gone and hit it.
examples: Objective not complete: Light the core. Not activated: core c1.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. (?P<id>\S+) survived with [0-9]+ of [0-9]+ hp\.(?: \S+ survived with [0-9]+ of [0-9]+ hp\.)*$
hints.text: Still standing. Check the ruler: which takes actually landed a hit?
examples: Objective not complete: Defeat the boss. b1 survived with 16 of 20 hp.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*\. The required condition never happened\.$
hints.text: The room's waiting on something. Reread the job; see what never moved.
examples: Objective not complete: Open the gate. The required condition never happened.

hints.match: ^Objective not complete: .*$
hints.text: Same miss twice. Watch the playback for the beat it goes wrong.
examples: Objective not complete: Destroy the grunt.
